```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
})
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
ichor_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/ichorCNA_longitudinal_summaries/1000kb_NST.csv"

meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/Tumor_fraction_by_site"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load ichorCNA results
# -----------------------------
df_ichor <- read_csv(ichor_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    id = Sample_ID_TP_number,
    tumor_fraction = Tumor_fraction
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id)
  )
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load metastasis site annotation
# -----------------------------
meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Join tumor fraction with site
# -----------------------------
df_tf <- df_ichor %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(tumor_fraction)) %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites)
  )
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Sanity checks
# -----------------------------
cat("Samples per site:\n")
print(df_tf %>% count(metastatic_sites))

cat("\nTumor fraction summary by site:\n")
print(df_tf %>% group_by(metastatic_sites) %>%
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          median = median(tumor_fraction),
          IQR = IQR(tumor_fraction),
          .groups = "drop"
        ))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Statistics
# -----------------------------
# Global comparison
res_kw <- kruskal_test(df_tf, tumor_fraction ~ metastatic_sites)

# Pairwise comparisons
res_pairwise <- df_tf %>%
  wilcox_test(tumor_fraction ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

write_csv(res_kw, file.path(outdir, "tumor_fraction_KW.csv"))
write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "tumor_fraction_pairwise_wilcox.csv"))

print(res_kw)
print(res_pairwise)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
site_cols <- c(
  brain = "#4DBBD5",
  bone  = "#E64B35",
  liver = "#00A087"
)

p <- ggplot(df_tf,
            aes(x = metastatic_sites,
                y = tumor_fraction,
                fill = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "Tumor fraction (ichorCNA)",
    title = "cfDNA tumor fraction across metastatic sites"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Add global p-value
p <- p + annotate(
  "text",
  x = 2,
  y = max(df_tf$tumor_fraction) * 1.05,
  label = paste0("KW p = ", signif(res_kw$p, 3)),
  size = 4
)

print(p)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Save
# -----------------------------
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_tumor_fraction_by_site.png"),
       p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_tumor_fraction_by_site.pdf"),
       p, width = 7, height = 5)

cat("\nSaved outputs to:\n", outdir, "\n")

```
